value: Mark Moir has a distinguished career in computer science research, spanning both academia and industry. Prior to Oracle's acquisition of Sun Microsystems, he held positions at Sun Labs and the University of Pittsburgh. At Oracle Labs, he founded and led the Scalable Synchronization Research Group, focusing on practical and theoretical aspects of concurrent, distributed, and real-time systems, particularly hardware and software support for scalable synchronization in shared memory multiprocessors. More recently, Moir has shifted his research to leading initiatives in blockchain and related technologies, exploring how these can enable accountable access to confidential information, with recent work including the implementation and formal verification of authenticated data structures and Byzantine Fault Tolerant consensus protocols.
